source.title: Attendance of the Prime Minister at Prime Minister's Questions since 1979
source.credit: Source: House of Commons Library, Attendance of the Prime Minister at Prime Minister's Questions since 1979 (SN04401), updated 4 November 2026
source.note_1: Following the death of David Cameron's son, PMQs were not held on 25 February 2009. The statements given by Gordon Brown, William Hague and Vincent Cable are included in the total number of PMQs
